data.description: Barsha South offers a perfect blend of modern living, family-friendly amenities, and a vibrant community atmosphere in the heart of Dubai.

data.answer:
This freehold community boasts relatively new properties, including a range of apartments and villas. The neighborhood is surrounded by popular tourist attractions, reputable schools, healthcare facilities, shopping malls, and leisure destinations. Its strategic location ensures easy access to major highways, connecting residents to key areas across Dubai.

Al Barsha South is the largest district within the master development of Al Barsha, offering a variety of residential options and a thriving community lifestyle. Divided into three sub-districts—Al Barsha South 1, Al Barsha South 2, and Al Barsha South 3—the area is a popular choice for both families and professionals. 

While villas for sale in Al Barsha South are predominantly found in Barsha South 2 and 3, the district is also home to some of the best apartments for rent in Al Barsha South, making it a versatile real estate hub.

Barsha South 1 is known for housing Aswaaq Mall and features a mix of villas and apartments, with a greater concentration of villas. Barsha South 2, home to Dubai Science Park, is a key hub for professionals, offering apartment complexes alongside spacious 4- and 5-bedroom villas. In Barsha South 3, the Arjan community takes center stage, featuring a cluster of residential buildings such as Geepas Tower, Lincoln Park, and Burj View Residence. 

Arjan is also home to popular Al Barsha South parks and recreation spots like Dubai Miracle Garden and Butterfly Garden, making it a family favorite. With its diverse property options and proximity to essential amenities, Barsha South Dubai continues to be a sought-after destination for residents and investors alike.

Residential properties in Barsha South Dubai offer a diverse mix of apartments and villas. The apartment complexes primarily consist of low to mid-rise buildings thoughtfully scattered throughout the community. 

Popular Buildings in Al Barsha South Dubai

Apartment complexes in Al Barsha South feature studios, 1 and,2, and a few 3-bedroom apartments. Some of the most popular buildings in the area are Vincitore Palacio, Green Diamond, and Samana Greens. 

Properties in Al Barsha South offer a variety of modern residential options, including well-designed apartment complexes catering to diverse preferences. Among these, Vincitore Palacio in Arjan stands out as a stylish, low-rise development by Vincitore Real Estate Development LLC. This 4-story building houses 175 units, featuring studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments. It also includes a health club on the podium level and beautifully landscaped areas, making it a sought-after choice for those exploring apartments for rent in Al Barsha South.

Another highlight of the properties in Al Barsha South is Green Diamond One, a twin-tower project by Diamond Developers. Each 8-story building offers ready-to-move-in 2 and 3-bedroom apartments, surrounded by lush communal gardens and eco-friendly courtyards. Similarly, Samana Greens adds to the appeal of apartments for rent in Al Barsha South, offering 131 units of studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments across its 5-story structure. With amenities such as basement parking, a fully-equipped gym, a swimming pool, a children's play area, and a retail center, this residence caters to modern living. 

Other notable developments in the area include Elz Residence, Bella Rose, Vincitore Boulevard, Meraki Genesis, Jewelz, and Resortz, each contributing to the vibrant and diverse real estate landscape of Al Barsha South.

Renting a Property in Al Barsha South

Renting a Property in Al Barsha South offers a range of options to suit different needs and budgets. Spacious apartments in Al Barsha South are available, with 5-bedroom units averaging AED 350,000 annually. 

For those seeking more privacy, villas in Al Barsha South are a popular choice, with 3-bedroom villas renting for an average of AED 217,000, 4-bedroom villas at AED 298,000, and luxurious 5-bedroom villas reaching AED 476,000. This diverse rental market makes Dubai Al Barsha South an attractive location for families and professionals alike.

Buying a Property in Al Barsha South Dubai

Buying a Property in Al Barsha South Dubai is an excellent choice for those seeking luxury and space. Known as one of the top areas to purchase villas in Al Barsha, the community offers bedrooms with different layouts with asking prices starting from AED 10 million, making it a prime location for upscale living and investment.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Al Barsha South?

data.answer:
Life in Al Barsha South offers a perfect balance of modern convenience and suburban tranquility, with family-friendly amenities, lush green spaces, and proximity to key attractions. The community's vibrant lifestyle caters to residents seeking comfort, connectivity, and leisure.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Al Barsha South

Transportation in Al Barsha South is convenient for residents relying on private vehicles, with well-connected roads ensuring seamless access to key areas of the city. For public transport users, buses and taxis are frequently available. 
The feeder bus F33 operates nearby, making it a popular option for local travel. While metro stations are at a fair distance, the closest one, located in Dubai Internet City, is just a 14-minute drive away. Residents can also use taxi-hailing apps like Uber and Careem or the RTA app for added convenience, making transportation in Al Barsha South both accessible and efficient.

Supermarkets in and Around Al Barsha South

Among the key amenities in Al Barsha South, access to various superstores ensures residents can conveniently meet their shopping needs.

Aswaaq Supermarket in Barsha South 2 stands out as a top choice for residents. In addition, there are several other options nearby, including LuLu Express, West Zone Fresh Supermarket, and Blackberry Grocery, ensuring that residents have easy access to a variety of shopping options for their daily needs.

Shopping Mall Near Al Barsha South

The community of Al Barsha South Dubai is surrounded by numerous shopping destinations and features two retail centers within its vicinity. My City Centre Al Barsha, a key hub for residents, is anchored by Carrefour Supermarket, offering a variety of shopping and dining options.

Residents also have access to popular malls near Al Barsha South, such as Al Barsha Mall and Souq Extra, while renowned shopping destinations like Dubai Marina Mall, Ibn Battuta Mall, and Mall of the Emirates are within a 20-minute drive, depending on traffic. 

These malls house top electronic stores, including Jacky’s Electronics, Fawasil Mobiles, and the Apple Store. For everyday shopping, Aswaaq Mall in Al Barsha South 1 provides a supermarket with a bakery, meat section, and ready-made food options, along with Rubiyan Grocery for quick essentials. This vibrant retail landscape ensures residents have everything they need close to home.

Schools and Nurseries in and Near Al Barsha South

Families in Al Barsha South have access to quality early education, with nurseries like Smart Start Kindergarten and Dibber Nursery located within the community. These nurseries offer a nurturing environment for young children, making Al Barsha South an ideal choice for families with toddlers.

For older children, there are several reputable schools near Al Barsha South, including Safa Community School, Nord Anglia International School Dubai, Repton Al Barsha, GEMS Founders School, GEMS World Academy, and Dubai Heights Academy. These schools provide a variety of curriculums and are within easy reach, ensuring families have excellent educational options close to home.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near Al Barsha South

Al Barsha South is home to several community mosques, including Ahmed Al Ghait Masjid and Abu Bakr Al Siddiq Mosque, providing convenient places of worship for residents. For those seeking a church, Casa de Oración Torre Fuerte is just a 7-minute drive from the community.

Clinics and Hospitals in and Near Al Barsha South

Residents of Al Barsha South have access to top-tier healthcare facilities, including Mediclinic Parkview Hospital, American Hospital Al Barsha Clinic, and Aster Hospital Barsha South, all located nearby. Additionally, renowned medical centers such as King’s College Hospital London Dubai, Al Khail Medical Centre, and Emirates Hospital Day Surgery & Medical Centre provide further options for comprehensive care.

For outpatient services, clinics near Al Barsha South include Aster Clinic Al Barsha, City Centre Clinic, and IMC Medical Center, among others. Pet owners will also find Vetcare in Barsha South to be an excellent facility, highly regarded among veterinary services in Dubai.

Location & Nearby Areas

Al Barsha South is strategically located in the western region of Dubai, offering a prime address that shares borders with some of the city’s most sought-after residential communities. Positioned near Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) and Arabian Ranches, it provides residents with excellent connectivity to key areas. Nearby residential clusters include Serena, Palmera, and Ali-Ali Residences, with Palmera being a notable part of Arabian Ranches.

From Al Barsha South Dubai, it takes approximately 18 minutes to reach Dubai Marina, while Palm Jumeirah, renowned for its waterfront attractions, is just a 14-minute drive via Hessa Street. The community also enjoys proximity to Dubai Motor City, adding to its appeal for those seeking a well-connected and vibrant lifestyle. The central Al Barsha South location makes it a highly desirable area for families and professionals alike.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Al Barsha South Dubai

data.answer:
Al Barsha South Dubai offers plenty of activities, from exploring the vibrant Dubai Miracle Garden and Butterfly Garden to enjoying family-friendly amenities and lush green parks. 

Restaurants

The community offers a variety of delicious dining options for its residents. Popular choices include Popeyes, Bazerkan Lebanese Restaurant, Khaana Badosh, PAAVO’S PIZZA, and Wendy’s. For even more options, residents can explore Grill Master Restaurant, Shakespeare & Co. Cafe Restaurant, and KFC Al Barsha South.

For coffee lovers, spots like Doh | Dohnuts and Coffee – Al Barsha South, Tim Hortons, and Hot & Cold Cafe provide the perfect places to relax and enjoy a refreshing brew. Whether craving fast food, international cuisines, or a coffee break, Al Barsha South caters to every palate.

Beaches Near Al Barsha South

Located about 20 minutes away, several popular beaches offer residents a perfect escape for relaxation and recreation. JBR Beach and Marina Beach are renowned for their vibrant atmosphere, with The Beach JBR featuring a variety of restaurants and hotels nearby. 

Jumeirah Beach, another favorite, boasts fitness facilities, jogging and cycling tracks, and a selection of dining options, making it an ideal spot for both leisure and activity-filled outings. These nearby beaches provide a perfect blend of convenience and entertainment for beach lovers.

Hotels in and Around Al Barsha South

Tourists seeking accommodation can find several well-regarded hotels in the area, including The S Hotel and Millennium Mont Rose.

The S Hotel, a top-rated 4-star establishment, features 246 spacious rooms equipped with modern amenities such as Wi-Fi, a minibar, a safety deposit box, a work desk, a tea and coffee maker, and a flat-screen TV. For added comfort, it offers 12 suites with separate bedrooms, living areas, and extra sofa sleepers, along with dining spaces that seat up to four guests. Conveniently located near popular lifestyle and tourist destinations, this hotel is a favorite among visitors.

Another excellent choice is Millennium Mont Rose, a 4-star hotel offering 198 serviced apartments with contemporary finishes. The property includes 72 studios and 126 one-bedroom apartments, complemented by amenities such as dry cleaning and laundry services, currency exchange, car rental, 24-hour concierge, and multilingual staff. Its prime location ensures easy access to key attractions, making it a great option for both short and extended stays.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

Al Barsha South Parks and Recreation offers residents a variety of ways to unwind and stay active. Parks like Al Barsha South Lake, Al Barsha South Park, and Al Barsha Pond Park provide serene green spaces for relaxation and outdoor activities. Nearby, you'll also find Al Barsha 3 Park 3, Al Barsha 2 Park 1, and other smaller parks that are perfect for strolls or family picnics.

Fitness enthusiasts have access to some of the best gyms in the area, ensuring they can maintain a healthy lifestyle. Popular options near Al Barsha South include Fitness HQ, Gold’s Gym Al Barsha Mall, Fitness First Al Barsha, and The Warehouse Gym.

For those seeking beauty and wellness, the community boasts an array of salons and spas. Renowned beauty spots like Grand Flora Salon, Senses of Asia Wellness & Beauty, and The Dollhouse Beauty Salon cater to diverse needs. Spas such as Cocoon Nail Spa, Jazz Lounge Spa, and Thai Professional Spa offer luxurious treatments. 

Cocoon Nail Spa, in particular, is celebrated for its personalized services, including nail repair, enhancements, and signature pampering sessions. This vibrant mix of amenities ensures that Al Barsha South parks and recreation truly enhance the lifestyle of its residents.

Community Events

The neighborhood hosts a variety of cultural and community events throughout the year. Additionally, the community enjoys engaging activities like movie nights, sports tournaments, fairs, and shopping festivals, fostering a vibrant and inclusive environment for everyone.

Attractions and Landmarks

Residents enjoy excellent connectivity to key destinations, with Dubai Marina Mall and Mall of the Emirates both just 18 minutes away. Cheeky Monkeys’ Al Barsha, a popular spot for families, is a quick 11-minute drive via Hessa Street (D61). Sports enthusiasts can reach Dubai International Stadium in just 12 minutes, while Dubai International Airport is conveniently accessible within 24 minutes, ensuring ease of travel and recreation.

Al Barsha South offers a dynamic lifestyle with a mix of modern amenities, excellent connectivity, and a family-friendly environment. Its growing infrastructure and proximity to key destinations make it an attractive choice for residents and investors alike.

Al Barsha South offers a variety of properties, including apartments, villas, and serviced residences, catering to diverse needs.

data.content:
Nestled to the south of the larger master development of Al Barsha, Al Barsha South stands out as a vibrant residential community in Dubai. Encompassing five distinct areas—Al Barsha South 1, Al Barsha South 2, Al Barsha South 3, Dubai Science Park, and Arjan—this neighborhood offers a blend of urban convenience and suburban tranquility. Popular for its family-friendly environment, the area attracts residents with its excellent amenities, prime location, and diverse real estate options.

Living in Al Barsha South combines the comfort of a suburban lifestyle with easy access to some of Dubai’s most sought-after destinations. Residents enjoy proximity to key landmarks such as Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Marina, and Mall of the Emirates (MOE). 

The Al Barsha South lifestyle caters to a wide range of preferences, with plenty of recreational opportunities, shopping destinations, and dining options nearby. Whether it’s exploring the lush landscapes of the Miracle Garden, spending time at Magic Planet, or enjoying Ski Dubai at the Mall of the Emirates, this community ensures residents are never far from entertainment.
